newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest, brokers said on Monday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were mostly higher, lifted by short-covering interest ahead of the close after prices drifted within narrow ranges for most of the day.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives. But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon on some late local selling interest," a local broker said.

"Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were mostly higher but there was no follow-through buying interest here. The ring sessions were quiet and there was no news of Chinese enquiries and (local) prices turned softer," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, April RSS3 eased half a cent to 125.50 U.S. cents a kg.
April RSS1 fell one cent to 177.50 Singapore cents (US$1.27) a kg.
March TSR20 eased half a cent to 170.00 Singapore cents (US$1.21) a kg.
